faq.q1: What if something goes wrong after optimization?
faq.a1: Go to the "Restore" page to restore your registry backup. It is recommended to back up the registry before optimizing.
faq.q2: Some apps don't work after cleanup?
faq.a2: Cleanup removes cache files. Some apps may need to regenerate cache. Restart the app if the problem persists.
faq.a3: Ensure your internet connection is working. If using KMS activation, verify the KMS server is available. Try switching to another KMS server.
faq.q4: How to restore uninstalled UWP apps?
faq.a4: You can re-download and install uninstalled UWP apps from the Microsoft Store.
faq.q5: How to restore Defender after disabling?
faq.a5: Click the "Enable Windows Defender" button on the Security Center page to restore it.
faq.a6: Ensure your internet connection is working. Installation requires downloading from official servers. If an older version of Office is installed, uninstall it first.
faq.a7: Yes, most optimization and cleanup operations require administrator privileges. Please run this program as administrator.
faq.q8: Do optimization settings help with gaming performance?
faq.a8: Some optimization items (such as disabling Spectre/Meltdown patches, enabling high-performance power plan, disabling game recording tools) can improve gaming performance.
